svg.aria-label: Three binding constraints: semiconductor access, certification throughput, workforce deficit
svg.text: These, not platform decisions, set the rate of India's autonomous naval transformation
9/10 dependency on US/Taiwan · 0/10 domestic at advanced nodes · marine-grade FPGAs, RF ICs, AI-edge NPUs
DGQA/CemILAC are platform-centric; no software-iteration, continuous-update cadence for autonomous systems
12,000–18,000 engineer and technician deficit in naval autonomy disciplines by 2030 under business-as-usual
All three are policy-lever addressable; the 2026–2028 foundation window is non-recoverable.
